tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an annual turnover of Rs. 45.56Lakhs in at least two financial years in any of the preceding five financial years i.e., 2025-26, 2024-25, 2023-24,2022-23, 2021-22.As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss statement duly certified by a chartered accountant.
